name: Measurements-CellProfiler
description: Extracts full morphology and intensity measurements from 2D fluorescence images using CellProfiler 4.2.6. Requires three pre-segmented greyscale mask images per input image: a Nuclei mask, a Cell mask, and an Aggregates/Foci mask. Produces per-object CSV tables covering shape, size, texture, and intensity features for each detected nucleus, cell, and aggregate. Suitable for studies relating foci/aggregate counts and intensities back to parent cells and nuclei. Configure mask filename suffixes to match your data and specify which fluorescence channels to measure.
command-line: python wrapper.py CYTOMINE_HOST CYTOMINE_PUBLIC_KEY CYTOMINE_PRIVATE_KEY CYTOMINE_ID_PROJECT CYTOMINE_ID_SOFTWARE

inputs.name: Suffix for Nuclei Mask
inputs.description: Suffix to identify the nuclei (greyscale) mask images

inputs.name: Suffix for Aggregates Mask
inputs.description: Suffix to identify some aggregates (greyscale) mask images

inputs.name: Suffix for Cells Mask
inputs.description: Suffix to identify the cells (greyscale) mask images

inputs.name: Channels to measure
inputs.description: List of all the channels of the original image to be used for intensity measurements. E.g. 1,2,3 for RGB.
